Intro: I hope your business is doing well. It is lively, in this part of town. I am sure you have seen your share of spoiled.
I am tired. There was an attack yesterday, and so, so many loyal men and women died. I…
Working for Our Lady requires mental fortitude—so many can't understand that we are doing good. Even my own colleagues.
Nadezdha has her reasons, but the rest are inexcusable. Our Lady abandoned her family business to support the rebellion.
They treat her attempt to feed all the citizenry equally as a crime. I hope you are not the same.
We are all recovering from the sick, sick royals. More places like this are vital for normalcy, especially with the spoiled still roaming.
